title: Runtime GCP OSCORE responses omit Content-Format
description: rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs dispatch_runtime_gcp converts CoapResponse into SecureResponseData with options=&[], discarding response.content_format. Decrypted clients receive CBOR/SenML-CBOR/error payloads without the CoAP Content-Format option. Encode canonical Class E option 12 into the OSCORE plaintext and assert it after decrypting the runtime response.
